import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P="/agent/jobs/4b88b03e-a581-4087-a81c-c6faa0ea4230/provenance/"
t1=pd.read_csv(P+"table_1_triad_geometry.csv"); t3=pd.read_csv(P+"table_3_nematode_conservation.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,4,figsize=(19,4.6))
lab=["Ce ABHD-14\n(AF model)","Hs ABHD14A\n(AF model)","Hs ABHD14B\n(AF model)","Hs ABHD14B\n(1IMJ crystal)"]
cols=["#2ca02c","#1f77b4","#d62728","#7f0000"]

a=ax[0]; x=np.arange(4); w=0.38
a.bar(x-w/2,t1.SerOG_HisNE2_A,w,color=cols,label="Ser OG to His NE2")
a.bar(x+w/2,t1.HisND1_AspOD_A,w,color=cols,alpha=0.45,label="His ND1 to Asp OD")
for i,(v1,v2) in enumerate(zip(t1.SerOG_HisNE2_A,t1.HisND1_AspOD_A)):
    a.text(i-w/2,v1+0.04,f"{v1:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8); a.text(i+w/2,v2+0.04,f"{v2:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
a.axhline(3.5,color="0.3",ls="--",lw=1); a.text(3.45,3.55,"3.5 A H-bond limit",fontsize=7.5,ha="right")
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); a.set_ylabel("distance (A)",fontsize=9); a.set_ylim(0,4.1)
a.set_title("Triad is assembled in all four structures",fontsize=9.5,loc="left"); a.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="lower right")

a=ax[1]
a.bar(x,t1.cavity_A3,color=cols)
for i,v in enumerate(t1.cavity_A3): a.text(i,v+6,f"{v:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=8.5)
a.set_xticks(x); a.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); a.set_ylabel("cavity volume (A^3)",fontsize=9)
a.set_title("Pocket next to the nucleophile is open",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")

a=ax[2]
vals=[34.9,35.0,45.9]; nm=["Ce vs\nABHD14A","Ce vs\nABHD14B","ABHD14A vs\nABHD14B"]
a.bar([0,1,2],vals,color=["#1f77b4","#d62728","0.6"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): a.text(i,v+0.6,f"{v}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
a.set_xticks([0,1,2]); a.set_xticklabels(nm,fontsize=8.5); a.set_ylabel("global identity (%)",fontsize=9); a.set_ylim(0,52)
a.text(0.5,24,"18 vs 19\ndiagnostic columns\nbinomial p = 1.00",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#333",
       bbox=dict(boxstyle="round",fc="#fff3cd",ec="#cc9a06"))
a.set_title("No preference for either human paralog",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")

a=ax[3]
sub=t3.head(7).iloc[::-1]
a.barh(np.arange(len(sub)),sub.pct_of_65_nematode_orthologs_identical,
       color=["#2ca02c" if "catalytic" in r else "#9ecae1" for r in sub.role])
a.set_yticks(np.arange(len(sub))); a.set_yticklabels([f"{r.C_elegans_residue} ({r.role})" for r in sub.itertuples()],fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate(sub.pct_of_65_nematode_orthologs_identical): a.text(v+1,i,f"{v}%",va="center",fontsize=8)
a.set_xlim(0,112); a.set_xlabel("% of 65 nematode orthologs identical",fontsize=9)
a.set_title("Active-site residues conserved across Nematoda",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
